defects: Composition order is reversed relative to gold: gold requires the immersion φ to be POST-composed with f (φ ∘ f : M → N'), i.e. φ maps the codomain N into a further space N'; the produced statement instead PRE-composes, with g : N → M an immersion into the domain of f, giving f ∘ g : N → M'. This is a different (and generally false) mathematical claim: e.g. take M=ℝ², M'=ℝ, f(a,b)=a|b| (continuous everywhere), g(y)=(y,0) an immersion/embedding of the x-axis; then f∘g ≡ 0 is C^∞ and f is continuous at (1,0), yet f is not even C^1 at (1,0), so the produced iff fails.

IsImmersionAt is invoked as `IsImmersionAt g y` with only the map and point, omitting the explicit smoothness degree and model-with-corners arguments that gold's signature `IsImmersionAt J J' n φ (f x)` requires; the smoothness level of the immersion is left unpinned/mismatched to the ambient n.

Because of the swapped composition direction, the produced statement's point hypothesis `hxy : g y = x` and the immersion point `y` do not correspond to the gold's immersion-at-`f x` condition, reflecting a structurally different (non-equivalent) setup rather than a mere relabeling.
